scope: Frozen Round 5 validation runs only: baseline target_vol=0.12 versus w60_v13 target_vol=0.13, both vol_window=60; no parameter search.

replay_verification.method: Two sequential in-memory run_backtest replays using frozen protocol/spec/dataset/strategy, followed by build_report; no replay artifacts written.

trigger.risk_rule: RiskPolicy repairs current holdings when actual exposure exceeds max_total_weight=0.8, before considering the fresh strategy target.

interpretation: The higher target raised actual exposure just above the 80% cap on July 11. Risk repair overrode its lower fresh target and kept the prior basket, while baseline rebalanced into 515880 on July 14. The ensuing price moves caused a 10,058.90 CNY relative equity swing on July 15 and materially explain the nonmonotonic validation outcome. Later path differences and costs also contribute to the final gap; event counts alone do not quantify attribution.
limitations: This is a deterministic diagnosis of already-inspected historical runs, not independent validation or a changed selection.
